description: This file defines the AuthListener class, which handles authentication-related events such as login success/failure, logout, signup success/failure, password reset, and request events in the Goteo application. It manages cookies, user sessions, and event subscriptions for auth processes.

classes.name: AuthListener
classes.description: Handles authentication-related events, manages cookies, user sessions, and event subscriptions for login, logout, signup, and password reset processes.

methods.name: onRequest
methods.description: Checks for remember-me cookie on each request, authenticates user if valid, and removes cookie if invalid.

methods.name: loginSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful login event, sets remember-me cookie if applicable, and logs a notice.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Handles logout event by removing remember-me cookie and updating user property.

methods.name: signupSuccess
methods.description: Handles signup success event, logs notice.

methods.name: loginFail
methods.description: Handles login failure event, logs info, and displays error message.

methods.name: signupFail
methods.description: Handles signup failure event, logs info, and displays error message.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Handles password reset event, displays info message.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns array of events this listener subscribes to, mapped to handler methods.
